verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and texting platform, so auto-replies and scheduled texts are a fair question for it. The pack only shows adjacent features: on-demand text sending via MCP, viewing missed calls, and Sona answering calls when the team can't. None of these is documented missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS auto-replies, or recurring or scheduled texts, and a one-off send is not a schedule.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
